hack.root_cause: ERC-3525 Callback Reentrancy — Double Mint (onERC721Received fires before state update)
hack.description: Solv Protocol's unaudited BRO vault contained a textbook ERC-3525 callback reentrancy bug that let an attacker loop a single deposit 22 times — turning 135 BRO into 567 million and extracting $2.73M, while Solv's five published audits covered every contract except this one.
